standard-dialogue.npc: Can you help me find a book I want? That snotty Arceuus Librarian won't even say hello, never mind actually helping me.

options.text: Sure, what book do you want?

steps.player: Sure, what book do you want?

steps.npc: I think I'd like to read: '[book name]'

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

steps.npc: I'm about to join the crew of a cargo ship, trading goods with the eastern lands. I hear our voyages can last for weeks, especially if the winds are slack.
I don't want to run out of stuff to talk about with the other sailors, so I'm doing plenty of background reading before we sail. Will you find my book, please?

standard-dialogue-while-finding-a-book-f.npc: Have you found my book yet? '[book name]'
It's just typical of the Arceuus snobs that their Librarian's too good to help customers like me. They ought to be grateful to you for doing her job for her.
I'll grab you later when you're not busy helping someone else.

standard-dialogue-turning-in-the-book.npc: Thanks, I'll get on with reading it. Meanwhile, you can have this other book of mine - I won't be wanting to read it again.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-them-after-.npc: Thanks for finding the book. I'll have to think up what I need next.
